jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Credit & Lending
jobs.description:
Mercury is building Mercury Bank, N.A., a proposed nationally chartered bank focused on serving ambitious businesses. Credit and lending are central to that mission, and as we migrate our charge card and term loan products to the Bank's own balance sheet and build the next generation of lending infrastructure, we need someone who can hold the full program together.



The Senior Technical Program Manager for Credit and Lending will own end\-to\-end delivery of the technology programs that power Mercury's charge card, term loan, and adjacent credit products. You will be the connective tissue between Engineering, Product, Risk, Compliance, Treasury, and Operations: setting strategy for how these programs run, surfacing tradeoffs that unblock leaders, sequencing the critical path, and ensuring that what ships is audit\-ready from day one.



We are looking for someone who has operated at this level before, in a regulated environment, at scale, with real accountability for outcomes.


* *Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC\-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.*


### **What you'll do:**


#### **Program ownership**


* Own the integrated program plan across all active credit and lending workstreams, covering milestones, dependencies, and critical paths across Engineering, Product, Risk, Compliance, Treasury, and Operations.
* Proactively manage sequencing, resourcing tradeoffs, and escalations. When initiatives are off\-track, you identify it first and bring a recommended path forward.
* Ensure Compliance, Treasury, and Operations readiness lands alongside product and regulatory milestones
* Drive incident learnings back into design, test coverage, and runbooks so each issue improves the underlying system, not just fixes the symptom.
* Contribute to the overall (proposed) Mercury Bank, NA technical program, collaborating with other TPMs to build a holistic view of progress and risks

#### **Governance and decision\-making**


* Keep a single source of truth for status, decisions, risks, and owners. Maintain a living RAID log with clear owners and impact assessments.
* Facilitate structured decision\-making by surfacing options and tradeoffs to leaders before problems escalate.
* Build and improve the operating systems that drive credit and lending product decisions: planning cycles, reviews, decision frameworks, launch readiness.

#### **Communication and influence**


* Produce concise, predictable updates calibrated to the audience.
* Synthesize complex cross\-functional information into recommendations that help executives decide and move.
* Produce documentation of program objectives, architecture decisions, and operational impacts that onboards new team members without requiring a meeting to explain it.
* Function as a trusted thought partner to engineering leads, product managers, and senior leadership.

#### **Execution and improvement**


* Identify inefficiencies and eliminate them through automation, AI tooling, or process redesign.
* Lead technical retrospectives and post\-mortems, ensuring learnings are systematized rather than forgotten.

### **What we're looking for:**


#### **Experience**


* 10\+ years of program management or technical program management in a high\-growth or regulated environment.
* Direct experience in financial services, fintech, or credit infrastructure. Compliance, audit, reporting and risk management obligations are familiar territory.
* Track record of operating at the department or business level, owning programs with multiple concurrent workstreams and cross\-functional accountability.
* Proven ability to communicate with and influence executive stakeholders, in writing and in high\-stakes meetings, without a senior manager to translate.
* Bonus: Familiarity with the lending tooling ecosystem such as loan origination, credit risk management and lending management systems.

#### **How you work**


* Product\-first. You evaluate everything through: what is the user problem, what is the fastest path to learning, what actually moves the needle.
* AI\-native. You use AI tools to do your actual work. You have built workflows or tooling that changed how your team operates. When you see a repetitive process, you automate it.
* Comfortable in ambiguity. You build structure where there is none.
* Systems thinker. You see dependencies, second\-order effects, and points of failure before they surface, and you build programs that account for them.
* Energized by building and operating. You do your best work designing the system and running it well once it is built.

### **What you bring:**


* Technical fluency. You can understand and challenge engineering decisions, identify technical risks early, and translate complexity for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication. You write documentation that clarifies hard decisions and build frameworks teams actually adopt.
* Commercial instincts. You understand the financial dynamics of a lending business well enough to evaluate tradeoffs with authority.
* High emotional intelligence. You build trust quickly across engineering, product, risk, and executive stakeholders. You navigate complex interpersonal situations without losing credibility or momentum.


Mercury values diversity \& belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. jobs.title: Product Risk Program Manager
jobs.description:
As a Specialized Assessment Product Risk Program Manager (SA PRPM), you will be a critical driver in Meta’s risk management and product integrity efforts. You’ll sit at the intersection of product, legal, and regulations — triaging and supporting risk review for new products and features that challenge company policy, introduce novel or untested risk, or require specialized scrutiny.Your work will shape how Meta assesses high\-risk product decisions, often in fast\-moving or ambiguous contexts. You’ll help guide cross\-functional partners through escalation workflows, support aligned decision\-making, and ensure that the right voices are in the room to evaluate complex tradeoffs. You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy—proactively identifying important problems, exercising independent judgment, and contributing to the strategy and roadmap for cross\-functional risk review. The ideal person will have exceptional judgment, strategic foresight, and the ability to operate across multiple risk domains.This is a senior individual\-contributor role. Success means managing and delivering large\-scale programs, aligning solutions across multiple teams, and gaining recognition as a subject\-matter expert whose advice is sought out across the product and risk community.  

  

  

### **Product Risk Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Support and manage the triage and escalation process for product risks that are novel, ambiguous, or policy\-challenging.
* Coordinate across Legal, Policy, Data Strategy, Engineering, and Product to ensure high\-risk reviews are surfaced and addressed with the appropriate depth and speed
* network with and appropriately involve key stakeholders, persuading diverse audiences to drive progress.
* Translate complex technical and product concepts into structured assessments and recommendations.
* Facilitate decision\-making through risk\-based frameworks that support both product velocity and compliance
* seek clarity on goals and priorities so work can move forward quickly, and escalate as needed.
* Ensure escalations are documented, tracked, and resolved with transparency and consistency, maintaining appropriate documentation and timely follow\-through.
* Identify gaps or breakdowns in current escalation/review processes and drive improvements in workflows, guidance, or tooling
* actively experiment and seek opportunities to simplify work through AI\-integrated workflows.
* Help Meta meet its legal and regulatory obligations and make decisions that reflect our mission, values, and principles, informed by risk reviews and compliance guidance.

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8\+ years of experience in program management, product operations, trust \& safety, privacy, compliance or in a related field
* Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver high\-pressure, high\-ambiguity projects involving dependencies across multiple stakeholders, teams, or functions
* Experience assessing and triaging novel or ambiguous product risks, particularly where no established policy, process, or precedent exists
* Strong communication and cross\-functional alignment skills — especially in navigating sensitive tradeoffs
* Familiarity with data flows, technical systems, and/or understanding of product risks and their applicable mitigations
* Track record of influencing decisions and driving progress without formal authority
* Experience building, improving, or operationalizing risk review, escalation, assessment, or governance processes
* Strong judgment in situations involving competing priorities, incomplete information, and significant business, regulatory, safety, privacy, or reputational risk
* Experience using AI/automation to improve complex workflows, analysis, decision\-making, or operational processes
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with comfort embracing ambiguity and improving systems

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working on privacy, content, legal, or compliance\-related product issues
* Experience with consumer\-facing technology, platforms, AI/ML products, infrastructure, or other technically complex products

Experience with product launches, 0* 1 products, emerging technologies, or novel product capabilities
* Experience working with AI agents, automation, or other emerging technologies to improve risk assessment and operational efficiency
* Understanding of regulatory, reputational, or policy risks related to consumer\-facing technology
* Experience developing and driving strategy or roadmap for cross\-functional projects and/or teams
* Background in triaging or adjudicating product\-level risks, ideally in a platform or infrastructure context
* Comfort presenting risk perspectives to senior stakeholders and leading through ambiguity
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

  

  

  

### **About Meta:**


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to lead the delivery of technology initiatives supporting claims, risk, and litigation operations. This role will own execution across a portfolio of claims\-related products and platforms, ensuring successful delivery of integrations, system enhancements, data initiatives, and operational capabilities.  

  

The TPM will serve as the connective tissue between engineering teams and business stakeholders, driving alignment across product, claims operations, legal, insurance, risk, and technology organizations. Success in this role requires strong technical program management skills, the ability to navigate ambiguity, and a track record of delivering complex cross\-functional initiatives.

* Own end\-to\-end delivery of claims technology programs spanning multiple engineering teams and stakeholder organizations

  

* Coordinate technical execution for integrations with third\-party administrators (TPAs), insurers, claims vendors, legal systems, operational platforms, and enterprise data services

  

* Establish program governance, milestones, risks, dependencies, and communication mechanisms across complex initiatives

This individual will serve as a force multiplier, translating ideas into structured plans, building executive\-ready materials, and driving high\-priority initiatives from concept through completion.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst, Amazon Freight
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon spent decades building one of the best supply chains in the world to run its own business, moving, storing, and delivering products fast and reliably. Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS) now opens that same network up to other businesses, so any company can use Amazon's multimodal ground and air freight, warehousing, distribution \& fulfillment, and parcel shipping to run their own operations. Think of it like what AWS did for cloud computing, but for supply chain, and it is just getting started.
  

  

We're looking for a Senior Business Analyst to turn ASCS's data into decisions – you don't just report what happened — you crisply explain why it happened, what it means for the business, and what we should do differently tomorrow. You'll dig into complex, messy datasets, build the dashboards and pipelines that make performance visible, and deliver the insight that changes what leadership prioritizes next. The role spans strategic and tactical work — from defining the analytical framework to writing the query yourself. It's highly visible, cross\-functional, and not for someone who wants a narrow lane.  

  

The ideal candidate will be a sharp SQL and BI practitioner who builds things that scale, translates ambiguity into structure, and transforms data into narratives that drive action. You are comfortable embracing ambiguity, translating multi\-channel performance data into a clear narrative, and changing a stakeholder's mind with evidence rather than opinion. You work backward from the customer, you dive deep rather than accepting the first plausible explanation, and you'd rather build a scalable solution once than answer the same ad hoc question five times.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Turn operational and performance data into insights and narratives leadership can act on — not just charts, the "so what."
* Work with large, complex, sometimes\-ugly datasets using the right tool for the job, whether that's SQL, Python, or a spreadsheet.
* Partner with Product, Program, Engineering, and Sales to define data requirements and build BI solutions that actually get used, not just launched.
* Build and own self\-serve analytics — dashboards, drill\-downs, alerts, and metric definitions — so performance is obvious at a glance across ASCS service lines.
* Define measurement frameworks that connect acquisition, engagement, and operational KPIs, and run retrospectives that end in specific optimization actions, not just observations.
* Identify what's actually driving key metrics, quantify the impact, and make the call on where the business should invest next.
* Build automated pipelines and reporting that cut manual effort and speed up decisions.
* Mentor junior analysts on technique, problem\-solving, and how to land a recommendation with a room full of stakeholders.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* 5\+ years of writing SQL queries and creating business intelligence reports using Tableau, Power BI experience
* 7\+ years of business or financial analysis, product costing, procurement, or a quantitative role experience
* 5\+ years of Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables) experience
* Experience applying basic statistical methods (e.g. regression) to difficult business problems
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to drive improvements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* MBA
* Experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or a related field
* Interest in exploring how automation and AI can power workflows, dashboards, and campaigns

**Overview**

This isn't a desk job; it's a front\-row seat to shaping how the U.S. military postures, moves, and sustains forces across the Pacific theater. As a Logistics Operations Analyst at Camp Smith, you'll translate complex engineering requirements and operational priorities into decisions that matter, delivering planning products and assessments directly to senior military and civilian leaders. You'll work at the intersection of joint logistics, engineering operations, and theater\-level planning, where your analysis drives real outcomes across a vast and contested region. If you thrive in high\-stakes environments and want your work to count, this is where you belong.

**THE MISSION**

The Pacific theater demands precision, adaptability, and deep operational know\-how. K2 is looking for a Logistics Operations Analyst to support a joint logistics and engineering organization at Camp Smith, Honolulu, HI. You'll analyze theater requirements, infrastructure constraints, and logistics dependencies, then turn that analysis into actionable products for decision\-makers. From deliberate planning to real\-world contingency operations, your work directly supports theater readiness, force posture, and engineering integration across Service components and regional partners.

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, logistics, operations research, architecture, military studies, national security studies, regional planning, or a related field

* Master's degree in engineering, logistics, operations research, systems engineering, national security affairs, public policy, or a related discipline

The role requires strong project leadership and sufficient familiarity with AWS cloud environments and Java\-based applications to engage technical teams, understand delivery dependencies and risks, and communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. The Technical Project Manager will coordinate cross\-functional and multi\-vendor teams; manage scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality, risks, dependencies, and change; and partner with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, architects, engineering and operations leads, executive leadership, and Federal stakeholders to achieve measurable outcomes.

**What You Will Do****:**


We are seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager to lead a diverse portfolio of technical efforts, including modernization initiatives, system and application enhancements, new capability delivery, platform improvements, integrations, and technology upgrades. This role will manage delivery from initiation through deployment and transition to operations, coordinating work across multiple workstreams, vendors, and agile teams while maintaining service continuity and alignment with business priorities.


The Technical Project Manager will establish delivery baselines and governance, manage requirements and change, track performance and financials, facilitate technical and business decisions, and coordinate quality, security, release, operational readiness, and stakeholder adoption. This individual will support initiatives involving cloud\-hosted applications, integrations, shared services, data exchanges, infrastructure, and emerging capabilities. Success requires sound judgment, technical curiosity, concise executive communication, and the ability to create accountability without displacing the responsibilities of Product Owners, Scrum Masters, architects, or Technical Leads.

* Lead projects through initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and control, deployment, transition to operations, and closeout, with clear acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes.
* Define and maintain project charters, scope, objectives, work breakdown structures, integrated schedules, resource plans, budgets, delivery roadmaps, and governance cadence.
* Manage day\-to\-day execution across multiple agile teams, technical workstreams, vendors, and shared services; clarify roles, commitments, interfaces, and decision rights.
* Partner with Product Owners and technical leads to translate business and technical requirements into prioritized, achievable release plans while maintaining traceability from objectives through delivered capabilities.
* Manage scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, procurement and vendor commitments, risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, decisions, and corrective actions using appropriate controls.
* Own project financial management, including budgets, forecasts, burn rates, variance analysis, Estimate at Completion, Estimate to Complete, and timely escalation of financial risks.
* Establish and administer integrated change control, assessing proposed changes for business value and impacts to architecture, scope, cost, schedule, security, operations, and contractual commitments.
* Coordinate architecture, application development, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, privacy, data, testing, configuration management, and operations stakeholders to meet delivery and governance requirements.
* Drive release and operational readiness, including environment and integration dependencies, test completion, defect disposition, data migration, deployment planning, rollback and contingency planning, training, communications, support readiness, and production handoff.
* Track technical dependencies across applications, cloud services, APIs, data exchanges, security components, environments, and shared platform capabilities.
* Coordinate delivery planning for AWS\-hosted environments and Java\-based applications, working with technical leads to understand architecture, security, integration, deployment, and operational considerations.
* Proactively manage implementation and transition risks, including workflow continuity, system\-of\-record decisions, overlapping capabilities, data synchronization, technical debt, testing scope, deployment sequencing, and operational impacts.
* Define and monitor delivery metrics and key performance indicators, such as milestone performance, forecast accuracy, throughput, cycle time, quality trends, defect leakage, dependency aging, and risk exposure; use data to drive recovery plans and continuous improvement.
* Prepare concise executive dashboards, weekly and monthly status reports, decision briefs, and forecasts that clearly communicate progress, financial status, risks, dependencies, tradeoffs, and decisions required.
* Facilitate planning sessions, technical reviews, risk reviews, stakeholder forums, retrospectives, and decision meetings; document actions, owners, due dates, and outcomes.
* Manage vendor performance against plans, deliverables, service expectations, quality criteria, and contractual obligations, escalating gaps and coordinating remediation.
* Maintain complete, audit\-ready project records, including baselines, plans, RAID logs, decisions, approvals, change records, status reports, meeting outcomes, and lessons learned.
* Build trusted relationships across Federal stakeholders, vendors, architects, delivery teams, and operations partners while promoting accountability, constructive conflict resolution

jobs.title: Program Manager - Automation
jobs.description:
The **Program Manager (Automation)** is responsible for the successful delivery of complex, safety\-critical aviation and defense programs, with a primary focus on contracts supporting the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and related government agencies. This role owns full lifecycle program execution from capture and proposal development through system delivery, certification and final customer acceptance.


The Program Manager is accountable for program performance across scope, schedule, cost, compliance and risk ensuring all deliverables meet stringent regulatory, safety and contractual requirements. This individual serves as the primary interface with government stakeholders and leads cross\-functional teams in a highly regulated, mission\-critical environment.


Key Responsibilities

* Program Leadership

* Identify, vet and negotiate with subcontractors in accordance with federal procurement standards

* Develop compliant and competitive program plans including Statements of Work (SOW), Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), Integrated Master Schedules (IMS), Basis of Estimates (BOE) and resource plans
* Conduct risk and opportunity analyses
* Program Execution \& Delivery

* Support system certification and approval processes, including documentation, testing and validation activities
* Ensure adherence to applicable standards
* Maintain audit readiness for government reviews and regulatory inspections
* Ensure compliance with export controls (ITAR/EAR) and security requirements

* Lead change control processes in alignment with contractual requirements, including engineering change proposals (ECPs)
* Monitor program performance using KPIs and Earned Value Management (EVM) as required
* Identify and resolve program issues proactively, including escalation to leadership and government stakeholders
* Financial Management
* Own program financial performance, including revenue, margin and cash flow
* Develop and manage program budgets, forecasts and Estimates at Completion (EAC)

* Approve and manage subcontractor and vendor expenditures

* Lead program reviews, including Program Management Reviews (PMR) and customer status briefings
* Build strong relationships with government stakeholders, ensuring transparency and trust
* Align internal stakeholders and resolve cross\-functional challenges to maintain program execution
* Leadership \& Team Management
* Lead and influence cross\-functional, matrixed teams across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality and field services
* Drive accountability, performance and collaboration across all program stakeholders
* Mentor and develop team members, fostering a culture of excellence, compliance and continuous improvement

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Program Management, or related discipline.
* 10\+ years of experience managing complex aerospace, aviation, defense, or government technology programs.
* Demonstrated success delivering large\-scale, mission\-critical programs for U.S. government customers.
* Experience managing software\-intensive systems, automation platforms, or complex system integration programs.
* Experience developing and managing IMS, budgets, forecasts, risk management plans, and program execution strategies.
* Strong knowledge of program management principles, change control, performance measurement, and financial management.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams in highly technical environments.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with executive and government customers.

Preferred Qualifications

* Direct experience supporting FAA Air Traffic Management (ATM) or National Airspace System programs.
* Experience with FAA automation systems such as ERAM, STARS, TFMS, or related modernization programs.
* Experience with air traffic control automation, decision support systems, or mission\-critical operational platforms.
* Familiarity with FAA acquisition processes and government contracting.
* Knowledge of aviation standards including DO\-178C, DO\-254, DO\-278A, or related standards.
* Experience with cybersecurity requirements for government systems.
* PMP certification.
* Master’s degree in Engineering, Systems Engineering, B

jobs.description:

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 5\+ years of relevant professional project management experience with a Bachelor’s degree; **or** 3\+ years with a Master’s; **or** 1\+ year with a PhD.
* Demonstrated experience leading IT projects or programs that span multiple functional organizations (e.g., business, IT, security, engineering).
* Demonstrated proficiency in cost/schedule management.
* Ability to work under general direction, independently determine approaches to solutions, and contribute to the completion of specific programs and projects.
* Strong communication and stakeholder‑engagement skills, including experience interacting with leadership and cross‑functional teams.
* Candidates must have a current U.S. Government Secret security clearance (at a minimum), to include a closed investigation date completed within the last 6 years OR must be enrolled in the U.S. Government Continuous Evaluation (CE) Program to be considered.
* Candidates must have the ability to obtain, and maintain, access to Special Access Programs as a condition of continued employment.

* Understanding of security and compliance frameworks (e.g., DFARS, Risk Management Framework) and related disciplines.
* Proven experience managing projects delivering complex, multi‑function enterprise IT solutions across business and technical teams.

### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

Serco is excited to continue supporting the F\-35 Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO). This contract provides program management support in support of the full acquisition lifecycle of the F\-35 program, to include development, production, and sustainment.


The F\-35 JPO International Directorate (ID) is the focal point for all F\-35 Fleet Users, to include U.S. Services, International Partners, and Foreign Military Sales programs to ensure ID integration throughout the F\-35 enterprise and to ensure the delivery of 5th Generation combat capability to Warfighters in support of coalition operations. The Contractor shall provide support to the National Deputies who are the F\-35 Program’s senior national representative for their Participant country within the JSF Program Office and are responsible for providing day\-to\-day representation of the cognizant Partner nation on all matters related to the F\-35 Program. The Contractor shall provide support to the U.S. Service Deputies who are assigned to the JPO to ensure immediate/critical U.S. Service insight to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT) and Senior Leadership Team (SLT). The Contractor shall provide support to the Foreign Military Sales USG Program Managers who represent the Foreign Military Sales Foreign Liaison Officers for country within the JSF Program Office and are responsible for providing day\-to\-day representation of the cognizant Foreign Military Sales nation on all matters related to the F\-35 Program.


Our **Foreign Military Sales (FMS) Program Analyst,** F\-35 Joint Program Office (JPO), Crystal City, Arlington, VA, is responsible for advising JPO FMS leadership on current security cooperation policy, case development and case execution practices. Our Analyst reports to the Business Policy and Operations Manager, who is the principal policy and financial advisor to the FMS Program Manager, responsible for ensuring the FMS Program is in accordance with the Secretary of the Air Force International Affairs (SAF/IA), and Navy International Programs Office (NIPO) policies and procedures. Focus areas include: security cooperation and security assistance policy; manpower requirements; development, implementation, and execution of FMS cases; Letter of Request (LOR)/Letter of Offer and Acceptance (LOA) inputs, to include amendments and modifications; and process improvement.


You will be part of a dynamic team of F\-35 JPO Program Analysts and Program/Project Managers who works closely with the customer and other key F\-35 National Security and Allied stakeholders to deliver quality F\-35 systems.


In this role, you will:


* Provide expert management in the areas of security cooperation policy, case development, and case execution.
* Interact with cross\-functional agencies, to include SAF/IA, NIPO, AFSAC, and NAVAIR, to ensure current FMS policies and procedures support the function of the F\-35 FMS Program.
* Review and interpret directives from higher authority regulations, instructions, periodicals, and publications to maintain current expertise and knowledge.
* Ensure new technology and lessons learned are incorporated into F\-35 FMS processes; establishes suitable methods of assessing and continually improving processes.
* Develop, evaluate, advise, and improve efficiency and effectiveness of work methods and procedures, and manpower utilization.
* Coordinate with FMS Program Managers to advise and support country teams in the areas of policy, case development, and case execution.
* Coordinate with Security Cooperation Enterprise to assist country teams in completing Pricing and Availability (P\&A), Letters of Offer and Acceptance (LOAs), amendment and modification packages in Security Cooperation systems, including DSAMS and RMIS.
* Use strong communication skills including the ability to communicate orally, via written letters and memorandum, email, and presentation. Ability to prepare and present convincing oral and written presentations at all levels of government and industry, and foreign allies.
* Manage Annual Case Reviews (ACR) required by the DSCA Reconciliation and Closure Manual (RCM), DoD 5105\.65\-M, is completed in a timely manner.

To be successful in this role, you will have:


* The ability to provide onsite support at the F\-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) at Crystal City, VA a minimum of 2 days per week, each week. Onsite days in the JPO office may increase to provide onsite support up to 5 days per week to support the needs of the customer. Exact days in office at the JPO must be coordinated with F\-35 customer and approved by your Serco manager.
* An active DoD Secret Security clearance.
* A Bachelor’s degree plus a minimum of 3 years out of 6 years of recent work experience related to international acquisition programs.
	+ OR an Associates degree and 4 years of additional work experience related to international acquisition programs (total of 10 years of work experience).
* Familiarity with DoD Instruction (DoDI) 5000\.2 (Operation of the Defense Acquisition System), DoD Directive (DODD) 5530\.03 (International Agreements), and the International Cooperation in Acquisition, Technology and Logistics (IC in AT\&L) Handbook.
* Demonstrated knowledge of the principles, policies, and practices of system acquisition to plan, organize, and coordinate critical aspects of the development, production, deployment, and sustainment of systems, subsystems, and equipment.
* Demonstrated knowledge of the Security Assistance/Security Cooperation (SA/SC) programs to include the understanding of the FMS sales process from case development, implementation, execution, to closure in accordance with the Security Assistance Management Manual (SAMM), DoD 5105

=================

  

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well\-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

**Business Operations Department**


As a part of the Vantage Operations team, the Business Operations department is responsible for ensuring standards for operation performance, maintaining customer leases, producing monthly customer electivity bills, generating regular reports, and supporting Operational Effectiveness. The Business Operations department also works closely with all Vantage departments to ensure customer success from the construction process through daily operations and delivery activities.

**Position Overview**


The Business Operations Program Analyst serves as a strategic partner to the Business Operations leadership team, responsible for evaluating operational performance across multiple functions, identifying emerging trends, risks, and opportunities, and providing actionable recommendations to support business decisions.


This role works across a diverse portfolio of operational programs and business functions, using existing data, reporting, and operational information to assess organizational performance, identify areas requiring leadership attention, and support continuous improvement initiatives. The ideal candidate is naturally curious, highly analytical, and able to connect information across teams to develop meaningful insights that drive better business outcomes.

**This role will be based in: Denver, CO or Ashburn, VA and is in alignment with our flexible work policy. (3 days on site required, 2 days flexible).**

**Essential Job Functions**

**Business Performance Analysis**

* Analyze operational performance across multiple Business Operations programs and functions.
* Identify trends, risks, opportunities, and performance gaps impacting business objectives.
* Interpret data from operational systems, reports, audits, reviews, and stakeholder feedback to develop meaningful business insights.
* Evaluate organizational performance and provide recommendations to improve effectiveness, efficiency, and scalability.
* Prepare executive summaries, business reviews, and leadership briefings.

**Strategic Decision Support**

* Provide data\-driven recommendations to support operational and strategic decision\-making.
* Assess the impact of operational initiatives, process changes, and business programs.
* Identify emerging issues and opportunities before they become significant business challenges.
* Support prioritization efforts by helping leaders understand operational impacts, risks, and potential outcomes.
* Assist with business cases and operational assessments to support investment and improvement decisions.

**Operational Oversight \& Governance**

* Monitor operational performance and program health across Business Operations.
* Evaluate adherence to business objectives, standards, and operational expectations.
* Identify recurring issues, process breakdowns, and areas requiring additional oversight.
* Support leadership with performance reviews, governance discussions, and operational assessments.
* Promote a culture of accountability through fact\-based analysis and performance visibility.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve processes, workflows, operational outcomes, and customer experience.
* Analyze root causes of recurring challenges and recommend corrective actions.
* Support process improvement and transformation initiatives through research, analysis, and outcome tracking.
* Measure and communicate the effectiveness of improvement initiatives.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Partner with leaders across Business Operations to understand business priorities and performance objectives.
* Facilitate discussions around trends, risks, operational challenges, and improvement opportunities.
* Present findings and recommendations to both operational and executive audiences.
* Act as a trusted advisor by translating complex information into clear, actionable insights.

**Job Requirements**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Finance, Analytics, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.

**Experience**

* 5\+ years of experience in business analysis, operational performance, strategy, consulting, program management, or a related discipline.
* Experience analyzing business performance and translating findings into actionable recommendations.
* Experience supporting leadership teams with decision\-making and strategic planning.
* Experience working across multiple business functions and stakeholder groups.

**Skills**

* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
* Ability to identify patterns, trends, risks, and opportunities from multiple sources of information.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong presentation and executive communication capabilities.
* Ability to influence without direct authority.
* Strong organizational and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and Microsoft Office applications.

**What Success Looks Like**

Program Director NewGen PA
\_\_

Leads the Tier 2 Architecture end\-to\-end Business Solution Design and coordinates development and implementation at the multinational, regional, or global function level, using ABB and/or third\-party resources. Leads project execution in accordance with company procedures, relevant cybersecurity regulations and standards, project objectives, applicable quality standards, safety requirements, and cost and scheduling targets. jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.
  
  

**What sets us apart drives us ahead:** between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.
  
  

(Senior) IAM Business Analyst (80\-100%)
  
  

Zurich \| Working from home up to 40% possible \| Reference 8269
  
  

Would you like to shape the future of IAM across workforce identities, cloud services and AI agents? As a Senior IAM Business Analyst / Requirements Engineer, you are an IAM specialist who understands SailPoint IdentityIQ well enough to shape feasible concepts and challenge technical options, while owning stakeholder alignment, requirements and processes. You bring together business, governance, data and technology perspectives, communicate confidently with technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and use data to support sound decisions. Working closely with IAM engineers, QA, operations, application owners, risk and audit, you turn emerging needs into sustainable processes and solutions. Customer Focus, Collaboration, Ownership and Trust guide how we work together and deliver value.
  
  

What You Will Do
  
Translate business, risk and regulatory needs into clear functional and non\-functional requirements, process models, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  
Shape and evolve IAM capabilities and governance models across workforce IAM, cloud services, non\-human identities including AI agents as well as policy\-based access control (PBAC), translating emerging needs into scalable processes and feasible solution concepts.
  
Develop solution designs for SailPoint IdentityIQ by assessing platform capabilities, defining workflows and data flows, and aligning concepts with IAM engineers and architects.
  
Analyze IAM data to identify trends, root causes, control gaps and automation opportunities, and present evidence\-based recommendations.
  
Act as the bridge between stakeholders and the distributed delivery team, supporting prioritisation, implementation, testing, rollout and adoption of sustainable IAM solutions.
  
What You Bring
  
Several years of experience as an IAM Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer or Consultant in IAM, with strong knowledge of IAM and IGA, access governance, RBAC/ABAC/PBAC, role engineering, certifications, Segregation of Duties and relevant control requirements; experience with IAM aspects of cloud services or AI agents is an advantage.
  
Practical knowledge of SailPoint IIQ/ISC and a sound understanding of systems and application architecture, including how corporate systems work together.
  
Proven experience in requirements engineering, process modelling and the software development lifecycle, with sufficient technical literacy to assess feasibility, understand implementation approaches and constructively challenge technical proposals.
  
Strong analytical and data skills, including SQL and BI tools (Python is an advantage), with the ability to turn complex information into sound decisions and clear recommendations.
  
Confident communication and facilitation skills with technical and non\-technical stakeholders in English; German is an advantage, combined with customer focus, ownership and attention to detail.
  
  

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt at \+41583998670\.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Intelligence Analyst, Global Security Intelligence
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Join an innovative team that delivers tailored intelligence products and services to protect Amazon's customers and business operations. In this role, you will produce risk assessments, conduct open\-source intelligence (OSINT) investigations, and translate complex customer requirements into scalable, actionable solutions. You will leverage OSINT and analytic tradecraft to uncover emerging threats and develop strategic products that help customers anticipate risks and look around the corner.  

  

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment that demands critical thinking, deep\-dive analysis, and the ability to manage competing priorities with exceptional attention to detail. They bring a genuine passion for delighting customers, collaborating across teams, and continuously raising the bar \- always seeking opportunities to refine processes, close gaps, and deliver more impactful products.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Collect, analyze, and interpret complex data using advanced analytical techniques; produce written strategic analysis, oral briefs, and tactical/investigative assessments in a cohesive and concise format to serve customers across business lines.
* Proactively identify and analyze relevant threats and trends and translate findings into actionable intelligence products.
* Conduct quick\-turn and deep\-dive open\-source investigations and monitoring.
* Engage with internal and external customers to understand their priorities and translate requirements into intelligence solutions that drive security strategies.
* Support business continuity, crisis, and security management teams, including as needed outside typical work hours during security incidents and emerging crises.
* Identify new solutions, methodologies, including using AI, to help improve information collection and reporting. Including the creation of maps or other visuals and tools to support the team's deliverables.

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences  

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why Amazon Security?  

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.  

  

Training \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, training, and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience handling confidential information
* Experience prioritizing and delivering projects on time in a fast\-moving environment
* Bachelor's degree in Intelligence Studies, International Relations, Political Science, Information Security, Criminal Justice, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
* Demonstrated expertise in analytical tradecraft and methodologies, including structured analytical techniques, OSINT investigation methodologies, and threat assessment frameworks.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex threat landscapes into clear, actionable intelligence for business decision\-makers.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience developing scoring methodologies and analytical frameworks that synthesize disparate data sources into decision\-ready intelligence, enabling customers to make data\-driven, risk\-informed decisions.
* Proficiency with intelligence analysis tools, OSINT platforms, data visualization software, and AI/ML\-enabled analytical capabilities.
* Master's degree in Intelligence Studies, International Security, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* OSINT certification or equivalent training
* 3\+ years in an intelligence, investigative, or analytical discipline
* Familiarity with the media and entertainment industry, including the lifecycle of a production

The position ensures technical deliverables are executed in alignment with business requirements, project timelines, quality standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.


**Duties \& Responsibilities:**

* Lead the planning and execution of technical workstreams for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP implementations, including integrations, data migration, reporting, environments, security, testing, and deployment.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, milestones, dependencies, resource requirements, and delivery schedules while proactively identifying and addressing risks and issues.
* Coordinate cross\-functional activities across internal IT teams, business stakeholders, system integrators, Oracle resources, and other external partners to ensure alignment and timely execution.
* Manage project scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, and change controls for assigned technical workstreams.
* Lead technical testing activities, including System Integration Testing (SIT), end\-to\-end testing, performance testing, security testing, and support for User Acceptance Testing (UAT), ensuring defects are effectively tracked and resolved.
* Coordinate Oracle Fusion environment management, release schedules, environment refreshes, code migrations, deployment activities, and production readiness.
* Develop and execute detailed technical cutover and go\-live plans, including readiness assessments, contingency planning, command center coordination, and issue escalation.
* Lead technical stabilization and hypercare activities following deployment, ensuring timely issue resolution and effective transition to ongoing operational and support teams.
* Facilitate technical governance, design reviews, project status meetings, and executive updates, providing clear visibility into progress, risks, decisions, and required actions.
Apply strong project management practices, including RAID management, resource and budget planning, vendor management, dependency tracking, change management, and executive stakeholder communication.  
* 

**Minimum \& Preferred Qualifications and Experience:**

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8\+ years of progressive experience managing complex enterprise technology, ERP, or business transformation initiatives, including technical workstreams.
* Experience delivering at least two full\-cycle Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP implementations.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP implementations, including integrations, data migration, testing, environments, security, cutover, and deployment.
* Demonstrated experience managing cross\-functional teams, system integrators, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Strong project management experience across scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, and governance.
* Excellent leadership, communication, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience delivering Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP implementations within a global, regulated, or medical device environment.
* Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise transformation or multi\-year ERP programs.
* PMP certification strongly preferred.
* Oracle Cloud, PMI\-ACP, Prosci, ITIL, or other relevant certifications preferred.
* Experience working across geographically dispersed teams and global business functions.

**Education:**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.


**Physical requirements/Work Environment**
------------------------------------------

This position primarily works in an office environment and requires frequent sitting, standing, and walking. Daily use of a computer and other digital devices is required. This role may require standing for extended periods when facilitating meetings or walking through facilities.


The physical demands of the position described herein are essential functions of the job and employees must be able to successfully perform these tasks for extended periods. Reasonable accommodations may be made for those individuals with real or perceived disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job described.


*Masimo is proud to be an EEOE/, M/F/D/V, and we are committed to Diversity at the corporate level.*

Epic Implementation Manager (Revenue Cycle)
jobs.description:
Overview:

Lead Enterprise Epic Implementations Across a National Health System


Prime Healthcare is an award\-winning health system headquartered in Ontario, California. Prime Healthcare operates 55 hospitals and has more than 360 outpatient locations in 15 states providing more than 3\.0million patient visits annually. It is one of the nation’s leading health systems with over 60,000 employees and physicians. Twenty\-one of the Prime Healthcare hospitals are members of the Prime Healthcare Foundation, a 501(c)(3\) not\-for\-profit public charity. Prime Healthcare is actively seeking new members to join our corporate team!


Are you an experienced Epic leader who has successfully driven full\-cycle implementations across complex hospital environments?


Prime Healthcare is seeking an experienced Epic Implementation Manager (Clinical) to lead enterprise\-wide deployments across our national health system. You will drive end\-to\-end clinical application implementations, partner closely with clinical and executive leadership, and ensure successful adoption across complex care environments. This is a high\-impact leadership role where your expertise shapes how care is delivered across dozens of hospitals.


What makes this role compelling:

* Lead enterprise\-wide clinical Epic implementations across 50\+ hospitals
* Influence provider workflows, patient care, and clinical outcomes

Own delivery across full lifecycle: design build* go\-live
* Lead and mentor large high\-performing analyst teams
* Partner directly with CMOs, Nursing Leadership, and Executives


Responsibilities:

Under the direction of the Epic Program Manager, the Epic Implementation Manager oversees Revenue Cycle applications, and is responsible for managing all aspects of future Epic implementations at Prime hospitals. The Implementation Manager will build relationships with hospital leadership to ensure corporate and local initiatives are incorporated into future implementations. After each go\-live, the Implementation Manager will oversee a comprehensive handoff to the Production Support team, ensuring a successful transition of support for the hospital. The Implementation Manager will supervise performance of all analysts on their team, which is comprised of the applications in their domain Revenue Cycle.


In this role, you will serve as the driving force behind enterprise Revenue Cycle Epic implementations, leading hospitals through each phase of the journey; from early planning and workflow design to go\-live and stabilization. As a leader, you’ll not only deliver successful implementations, but also mentor and develop your team while building strong, lasting partnerships across the organization.


On any given day, you’ll collaborate with clinical and executive leaders to align system design with real\-world care delivery, guide your team through build and testing milestones, and proactively navigate challenges to keep implementations on track. You’ll be at the center of the action during go\-live, ensuring teams are supported, workflows function as intended, and clinicians are set up for success.


What You’ll Do:

* Lead end\-to\-end Clinical Epic implementations
* Oversee design, build, testing, training, go\-live, and stabilization
* Partner with clinical stakeholders to align workflows and system design
* Ensure adoption of best\-practice clinical workflows
* Lead, coach, and manage clinical application analyst teams
* Drive milestone execution, risk mitigation, and delivery outcomes
* Oversee post\-go\-live transition to support teams
* Travel Requirement: This is a remote role that requires frequent travel (up to 50–75% annually) to hospital sites across the U.S., notably during key implementation phases.


Travel Requirement: This is a remote role that requires frequent travel (up to 50–75% annually) to hospital sites across the U.S., notably during key implementation phases.

* Six (6\) or more years of applicable work experience required.
* Minimum five (5\) years of experience working with electronic medical record required.
* Experience leading an Epic implementation required.
* Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Management, Computer Science, or related field preferred.
* Minimum four (4\) years of experience with an integrated healthcare information system preferred.
* Minimum four (4\) years of experience in project management preferred.
* Knowledge of healthcare industry and hospital operations preferred.
* Experience leading large teams.
* Strong communication and organizational skills


\#LI\-SM6

Prime Healthcare offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package that provides employees the flexibility to tailor benefits according to their individual needs. Our Total Rewards package includes, but is not limited to, paid time off, a 401K retirement plan, medical, dental, and vision coverage, tuition reimbursement, and many more voluntary benefit options. YouTube Biz Segment GTM is responsible for designing and delivering our service models for our Business Development, Creator and Consumer Success, and Partner Engineering teams to drive sustainable partner growth and customer lifetime value. The YouTube Business Central Strategy and Operations Team is responsible for leading global, cross\-functional, strategic initiatives to drive the unprecedented growth and health of the YouTube creator and partner ecosystem. The core capabilities of the team include strategic planning and business operations, incentives design and operations, and business strategy and operations for the three regions: Americas, EMEA, and APAC.

US: $100000 \- $141000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits

jobs.title: Lead Finance Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Crunchyroll**
---------------------



Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super\-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200\+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in\-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.



Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

**About the role**
------------------



In the role of Lead Finance Data Analyst, you will report to the Vice President, Accounting Systems and Data Governance.



We are considering applicants for our Los Angeles, California office.



You will lead the analysis, governance, validation, and integration of finance data used across accounting, reporting, and finance systems. You will partner with Accounting, Finance, Technology, and business teams to define trusted data standards, strengthen SOX\-relevant controls, resolve data quality issues, and support changes to financial systems and interfaces. The role combines hands\-on data analysis with process and control leadership to help ensure finance data is accurate, complete, timely, traceable, and fit for downstream use. Success will be measured by improved data quality, effective control execution, and reliable delivery of finance data changes across the system landscape.


### **Core Areas of Responsibility**


* **Finance Data Governance:** Establish and maintain finance data definitions, ownership, lineage, critical data elements, data quality rules, and governance standards across source systems, integrations, subledgers, ERP, and reporting environments.
* **Data Quality and Validation:** Design and execute validation routines, reconciliations, exception monitoring, root\-cause analysis, and remediation plans to improve the accuracy, completeness, cutoff, consistency, and traceability of finance data.
* **SOX Controls and Auditability:** Partner with control owners to design, document, operate, and improve SOX controls over finance data, interfaces, system\-generated reports, master data, and change activity; maintain evidence and support audit and testing requests.
* **System Integration and Change Delivery:** Define finance data requirements and validation criteria for new or changed integrations, interfaces, transformations, and system implementations; coordinate user acceptance testing, cutover, defect resolution, and post\-production validation.
* **Change Management and Stakeholder Partnership:** Assess impacts of data and process changes, coordinate communications, training, and procedures, and lead cross\-functional issue resolution to drive adoption while minimizing control, reporting, and operational disruption.

**About You**
-------------



We get excited about candidates, like you, because...


* You have 8\+ years of experience in finance data, accounting systems, financial systems analysis, data governance, or related roles, including ownership of complex cross\-functional initiatives.
* You have a strong understanding of accounting data flows and financial reporting requirements, including how transactions move from operational systems through integrations and subledgers into the general ledger and reporting environments.
* You have hands\-on experience with finance data governance, including data definitions, ownership, lineage, critical data elements, data quality controls, metadata, and issue remediation.
* You have experience designing, executing, or supporting SOX controls over financial systems, interfaces, reports, master data, or data changes, and understand control documentation, evidence, and audit testing expectations.
* You possess advanced data validation and reconciliation skills, including SQL\-based analysis and structured testing of large financial datasets.
* You have experience with system integration and data transformation concepts, including source\-to\-target mapping, interface controls, file\- and API\-based integrations, error handling, and downstream reconciliation.
* You have led or materially supported system change initiatives, including requirements, user acceptance testing, cutover, post\-implementation validation, process documentation, and change management.
* You have experience with ERP and finance platforms such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Coupa, Concur, or comparable systems.
* You possess strong analytical judgment and can translate accounting, control, and reporting requirements into scalable data and system requirements.
* You have a bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field; CPA, CISA, or recognized data governance certifications are a plus.

**About the Team**
------------------



The Accounting Systems and Data Governance team connects accounting requirements, data standards, controls, and technology to support reliable, scalable financial operations. The team partners across Accounting, Finance, Technology, and business functions to strengthen finance data integrity and improve how financial information moves through Crunchyroll's systems. This role is a senior individual contributor and key point of coordination for finance data governance, validation, and change initiatives. Success is measured through trusted data, effective controls, and dependable system delivery.


**Why you will love working at Crunchyroll**
--------------------------------------------



In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:


* Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.
* Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.
* Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance
* Health Saving Account HSA program
* Health care a

jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**Los Angeles or Boston (hybrid)**



RedCircle is helping creators to turn their podcast into a business. As an Analyst, you'll play an integral part in our mission as you work with our finance, product, and growth teams to make sure we have the data, systems, and processes we need in order to grow the business. This role will work end\-to\-end across our data lifecycle, split between platform work (ensuring all of our data sources are connected to the team's tools, checked for quality, and modeled to support business uses) as well as distribution work (assisting the teams with building and maintaining dashboards, analyses, and other data products for ongoing and ad hoc needs).



If you love to dig deep into the numbers, have a customer\-first mindset, and are interested in podcasting / media / influencers, this is a great gig for you. Podcasting is \*exploding\*, and this is a chance to build a career at one of the top technology startups in the space.


### **Core Responsibilities**


* Act as a "full stack" data analyst, covering data analysis, visualization, data modeling in dbt, and ETL pipeline. You're not expected to be an expert in all these areas, but you should be interested in building your skills across this range and using AI to extend your skillset.
* Bring strong curiosity to what drives our business and the patterns reflected in our data, and use your analytical skillset to provide insights and tools to support company growth in direct collaboration with our CEO and CRO.
* Update and improve our data pipeline and data models to ensure complete and accurate information is available to teammates and connected tools.
* Collaborate with product, sales, leadership, and finance team members to conduct analyses that support business growth and product decision\-making. Examples of possible projects include: funnel evaluation, sales forecasting, revenue reporting, product analytics, and marketplace analysis.

### **A great candidate has/is…**


* 4\+ years of experience in a highly analytical role, with a deep skillset in one or more data analytics area (ETL pipelines, dbt data modeling, business intelligence) and exposure to the full data stack, including SQL, dbt, Python, and data warehouses
* 3\+ years of experience collaborating with growth or product teams to address core needs, communicate with nontechnical teammates, and equip them with relevant data tools and access
* A self\-starter who is excited about learning and testing new skills and tools, including AI, to improve availability and usefulness of data across the team
* Gets jazzed about owning projects from end\-to\-end. We're a small team, so you'll be responsible for a lot and you'll need to operate autonomously
* Can work hybrid in\-person at the RedCircle office in Los Angeles or Boston 3\-4 days per week


**Compensation**



RedCircle is committed to providing competitive compensation, equity, and benefits. Compensation for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the candidate's experience, and the scope of the role, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated base salary range for this role is $75\-130k. New hire offers typically fall in the first half of the range. The higher end of the range may be considered for candidates who significantly exceed the minimum experience requirements and bring advanced skills and specialized expertise.


**About RedCircle**



RedCircle is everything a podcaster needs to run their podcast as a business. With tools for analytics, growth, payments, and advertising revenue, podcast creators use RedCircle as their command center for their podcast. RedCircle also provides a first\-of\-its\-kind podcast advertising platform, which helps brands scale ad campaigns across its thousands of podcasts in just a few clicks. As consumers, creators, and brands all flock to the podcasting medium, RedCircle is providing the picks and shovels to help all 3 groups transact.



With over 100 million monthly downloads, RedCircle is growing its community of podcasters and helping deliver millions in revenue for its creators. The company is growing quickly, is backed by some of Silicon Valley's top VCs, and is growing its team to keep up. If you want to help podcasters turn their art into income, this is the place for you.



RedCircle is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager - Strategic Accounts
jobs.description:
**Dynamo Software** est un éditeur mondial de premier plan de solutions SaaS de recherche et de gestion de portefeuille pour le secteur de la FinTech. Sa plateforme SaaS, hautement configurable et adaptée aux spécificités du secteur, répond aux enjeux de l’univers de l’investissement alternatif. Depuis plus de 20 ans, la plateforme Dynamo™ améliore la productivité des équipes de levée de fonds, de transaction, de recherche, de services aux investisseurs, de gestion de portefeuille et de conformité dans le monde entier. Ensemble, les plus de 1 000 clients de Dynamo gèrent plus de 10 000 milliards de dollars d’actifs. Soutenue par les plus grandes sociétés de capital\-investissement au monde – Blackstone Growth et Francisco Partners – Dynamo souhaite étoffer ses équipes pour répondre à la demande croissante pour ses solutions technologiques financières.

 **Aperçu du poste:** Tu accompagnes un portefeuille de clients stratégiques, du kick off à l'adoption durable de la plateforme. Chef d'orchestre d'un programme de plusieurs mois, tu coordonnes le client, les équipes internes (Produit, Tech, Sales) et les parties prenantes : chantiers en parallèle, interlocuteurs de tous niveaux, sujets techniques à trancher. Tu es le point de référence du client de bout en bout.

 **Descriptif du poste (au quotidien)**

  


1\. Phase de déploiement


* Construire et piloter le plan de déploiement : lots, jalons, dépendances, chemin critique
* Comprendre les spécificités du client pour adapter la solution à ses besoins : processus métier, cas d’usage, exigences techniques
* Déployer la plateforme avec le client et l’équipe technique : environnements, configuration initiale, flux d’intégration (API, webhooks, mappings de données, SSO, recettes)
* Tenir la gouvernance du projet : comités de pilotage, comptes rendus, décisions, risques et points bloquants

  



2\. Phase d’adoption


* Orchestrer la relation client en organisant les points réguliers et en conseillant sur les meilleures pratiques, grâce à une expertise fonctionnelle solide
* Former et accompagner les équipes du client, du key user à l’utilisateur final, y compris lors des changements d’équipe côté client
* Naviguer entre les interlocuteurs opérationnels, les équipes IT, les prestataires et partenaires du client et son comité de direction, en adaptant le discours au niveau d’interlocuteur

  



3\. Phase de fidélisation et expansion


* Collaborer avec les équipes internes pour garantir le succès des projets : avec les développeurs sur les problématiques techniques, avec le Produit pour adapter finement les fonctionnalités, avec les commerciaux pour identifier les besoins futurs
* Coordonner les projets spécifiques par un cadrage exhaustif des demandes, des dépendances et des zones de friction éventuelles, jusqu’à la mise en production
* Détecter de nouvelles opportunités en identifiant les besoins complémentaires du client et les axes de développement futurs, techniques ou fonctionnels

  


**Profil recherché:**


* Diplômé(e) de formation supérieure (eq. Bac \+5\)
* 6/7 ans d’expérience en tant que chef de projet implémentation dont une partie sur de la gestion de Grands Comptes : tu as déjà accompagné des clients stratégiques dans un contexte international
* Du cadrage : savoir distinguer le besoin réel du besoin exprimé, tenir un périmètre et un calendrier, dire non ou reformuler une demande sans dégrader la relation
* La capacité à traduire une contrainte technique en impact métier, et inversement
* Une vraie aisance technique : tu n’es pas développeur, mais API, webhook, mapping de données et environnement de recette font partie de ton vocabulaire, et tu peux échanger avec des équipes IT sans intermédiaire
* Fluent anglais/français

  


**Ce que nous offrons:**


* La possibilité d’avoir un IMPACT. Les bonnes idées viennent de chacun au sein de notre organisation. Nous sommes suffisamment agiles pour adopter de nouvelles idées et de nouvelles orientations.
* Une culture de travail très attractive au sein d’une entreprise technologique établie. Nous sommes fiers de notre travail et de nos équipes.
* Le candidat retenu aura l’opportunité d’interagir avec toutes les facettes de notre entreprise en croissance et de définir son propre parcours de carrière.
