jobs.title: Global Operations Analyst, Fleet Management
jobs.description:
As the largest global shared micromobility business, Lime is on a mission to build a future where transportation is shared, affordable and carbon\-free. A Time Magazine 100 Most Influential Company, Lime has powered more than one billion rides in close to 30 countries across five continents, spurring a new generation of clean alternatives to car ownership. Learn more at li.me.


Lime is hiring a Global Operations Analyst to join our Fleet Management team! Reporting to the Fleet Management leader, you will help turn operational data, stakeholder input, and recurring business needs into reliable processes and clear actions across global markets. You will work closely with Local Ops, Finance, Supply Chain, and other cross\-functional partners to maintain critical operating rhythms, improve visibility, and strengthen how Fleet Management programs scale.


This is an opportunity for an organized, analytical operator who enjoys connecting data, people, and process. You will help investigate operational issues, improve reporting quality, coordinate follow\-through, and develop practical solutions that enable teams to operate more consistently as the business evolves.


This is a remote\-first position. Candidates based in London, Paris, Lisbon or a comparable time zone are preferred to support effective collaboration across global teams. The role may require occasional in\-person support at Lime offices or warehouses and occasional travel to support business operations.

**What You'll Do:**

* Manage Reporting \& Operating Rhythms: Own the execution of established recurring reporting and operating rhythms across Fleet Management, ensuring deliverables are accurate, timely, and actionable.
* Build \& Maintain Reporting Tools: Build, maintain, and improve queries, dashboards, and recurring reports using established data sources and templates, making practical improvements and partnering on more complex changes.
* Investigate Operational Issues: Partner with Local Ops and other stakeholders to investigate and resolve fleet\-management issues, including asset decay, operational holds, cross\-market shipments, and related execution gaps.
* Coordinate Fleet Programs: Coordinate operational programs across warehouse transitions, battery operations and training, compliance reporting, battery allocation, fleet availability, and the transition toward 100% EV operations.
* Drive Operating Cadence \& Follow\-Through: Run the day\-to\-day operating cadence for assigned workstreams, including action tracking, status communication, follow\-through, and timely escalation of risks or blockers.
* Identify Process \& Data Improvements: Identify data and process gaps, clarify ownership, and partner with relevant teams to improve reporting quality, responsiveness, and operational performance.

**About You:**

* Operational Experience: You have 2\+ years of experience owning recurring operational work, reporting, coordination, or process execution in a fast\-moving environment
* Data \& Reporting Skills: You are comfortable working with operational data and using spreadsheets, dashboards, or similar reporting tools to investigate issues and communicate findings.
* Communication: You communicate clearly in writing and verbally, and can translate complex or incomplete information into practical next steps for different audiences.
* Organization \& Prioritization: You are highly organized, responsive, and able to manage competing priorities while maintaining attention to detail and follow\-through.
* Process Improvement: You bring a process\-improvement mindset: you look for patterns, clarify ownership, and turn one\-off work into scalable, repeatable ways of operating.
* Collaboration \& Adaptability: You are collaborative and adaptable, with the judgment to build strong relationships and work effectively across global teams, functions, and time zones.


Preferred Experience:

* Fleet \& Operations: Experience in fleet, warehouse, supply chain, mobility, asset operations, logistics, or another operationally complex environment.
* Data \& Business Intelligence: Experience building or maintaining SQL queries, business\-intelligence dashboards, recurring reporting, or operational data tools.
* Program \& Project Management: Experience supporting cross\-functional programs, project management, change management, or operational process launches.
* Global \& Remote Operations: Experience working in a global, remote\-first, or market\-based operating model.


\#LI\-SP1


\#LI\-Remote


If you want to make an impact, Lime is the place for you. Not sure if you meet all the qualifications? If this role excites you we encourage you to apply. Explore all opportunities on our career page.


Lime is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe different perspectives help us grow and achieve more. That’s why we’re dedicated to building and developing a team that reflects a wider range of backgrounds, abilities, identities, and experiences. **Notre Opportunité :**

Le département Forensic \& Integrity Services accompagnent nos clients pour répondre à leurs enjeux d’intégrité, de compliance et d’éthique.


Dans un environnement où la réglementation compliance qui s’impose aux entreprises se renforce et où les exigences en matière d’éthique s’accroissent, notre équipe pluridisciplinaire intervient sur :

* La conception, l’évaluation et l’amélioration de programmes de compliance afin de minimiser leur risque de corruption, de fraude et, plus largement, de non\-compliance.
* Les investigations en cas de fraude suspectée ou avérée (corruption, détournement d’actifs, fraude aux états financiers, blanchiment d’argent, infractions à des règlements spécifiques), ou à la demande des autorités de régulation.


Pour ce faire, nous nous appuyons sur une triple expertise :

* Gestion des risques : compliance, contrôle interne, audit interne, audit financier
* Innovation digitale : financial data analytics, data science, digital forensic
* Connaissance de la réglementation (Sapin 2, FCPA, sanctions, etc.), au service de dispositifs opérationnels




**Vos principales responsabilités :**

Intégré(e) dans notre équipe IT Forensic, vous travaillerez sur des cas concrets d’analyse de données lors d’investigation de fraude ou de conformité légale (SAPIN2, GDPR, Secret des affaires etc…)

* Analyser aussi des volumes de données importants en travaillant sur les opérations et les résultats financiers de nos clients (Groupes internationaux, CAC 40, …).
* Maîtriser les différentes technologies et architectures utilisées par nos clients (ERP, bases de données, etc..) et vous adaptez, si besoin est, les moyens d’analyse des données.

**Vos compétences pour réussir :**

* Vous maîtrisez divers des langages de programmation par ex : SQL, Java, PYTHON, etc…
* Vous avez une expérience ou une appétence dans des logiciels de Dataviz tels que Tableau Software, PowerBI ou Qlik.
* Vous avez des connaissances avancées en mathématiques/statistiques.
* Vous connaissez les problématiques inhérentes aux systèmes informatiques et vous avez une appétence pour les problématiques financières et un gout pour l’investigation.




**Ce que nous recherchons :**

* Vous êtes étudiante ou étudiant au sein d’une grande école de commerce ou d’ingénieurs ou d’un cursus universitaire en gestion ou finance ;
* Vous recherchez une alternance d’une durée du 12 ou 24 mois.

* Votre rigueur et votre autonomie vous permettent d’intervenir pour gérer des problématiques métiers et informatiques dans des situations variées et complexes de différents secteurs d’activités.

**Etes\-vous prêt à façonner votre avenir avec confiance ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui.**

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description:
### **About Alma**



At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well\-balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place, serving merchants and consumers.



Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience, without encouraging bad debt.



As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered more than 25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.



With 380\+ Almakers and €100M\+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!


### **About the team**



Revenue at Alma covers the entire customer lifecycle, from lead generation to churn. It brings together Marketing, Partnerships, Sales and Account Management, representing more than 100 talented professionals.



Revenue Operations plays a key role in helping these teams work together around shared goals, reliable data and efficient processes. The team supports Revenue leaders in improving performance, making better decisions and scaling the organisation.



This position is a permanent contract, based in Paris, with 2 days of remote work per week.



You will report to Basil Lizotte, and work closely with Revenue teams, the Central Data Team, Ops \& Risk, Product and Tech.


### **About the job**



As Senior Business Analyst, Revenue Operations, you will create strategic insights that help Alma's Revenue teams understand their performance, identify growth opportunities and improve their speed and efficiency.



You will work at the intersection of data, business and strategy, turning complex questions into clear recommendations and practical tools.


#### **Build reliable data foundations for Revenue**


* Build and evolve business\-facing data models by combining relevant CRM, revenue and operational data sources.
* Improve and maintain existing models and contribute to reliable end\-to\-end data pipelines.

#### **Turn business questions into strategic insights**


* Analyse Alma's target markets, market share, market dynamics and the key drivers behind commercial wins.
* Design ad hoc tools and models to help Revenue teams answer tactical business questions and make faster decisions.

#### **Improve performance monitoring and revenue growth**


* Build and manage dashboards, KPIs and revenue forecasts so teams and leadership can monitor business health and progress against their goals.
* Support Revenue leaders in setting the right targets, understanding growth dynamics and prioritising their roadmap.

#### **Drive data excellence across Revenue**


* Promote data\-informed ways of working across Marketing, Partnerships, Sales and Account Management.
* Collaborate closely with the Central Data Team to maintain high standards of data quality and consistency across the organisation.

### **You will work with**



SQL, Looker, LookML, Claude Code, Python, dbt, BigQuery, GCP, Rudderstack, Segment, Salesforce


### **About you**


#### **To succeed in this job**


* You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable working with large datasets, raw CRM data and revenue\-related information, including Salesforce data.
* You have experience building business\-facing data models, dashboards, forecasts or performance analyses from the initial question through to clear recommendations.
* You can define relevant KPIs, assess business impact and communicate complex analysis in a clear and actionable way to different stakeholders.
* You have approximately 4 to 7 years of experience in data analysis, business analysis or a similar role, ideally in a fast\-growing technology or fintech environment.

#### **And it will be nice if you also**


* You have experience with Looker and LookML.
* You are comfortable with Python and modern data tools such as dbt, BigQuery or GCP.
* You have worked with tracking tools such as Rudderstack or Segment, as well as experimentation methodologies such as A/B testing, significance testing and causal analysis.
* You are curious about AI\-assisted tools and are interested in using tools such as Claude Code in your daily workflow.


Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.


### **Your Alma experience**


#### **The culture**



At Alma, collective intelligence is at the heart of the way we work. We are building an international company in a fast\-growing environment, where people are encouraged to take ownership, share ideas and learn from one another.



You will have access to our Learning \& Development Platform, regular feedback and opportunities to develop your expertise and career path. As Alma continues to grow across Europe, you will have the opportunity to work with colleagues from different teams, countries and areas of expertise.



We are committed to building a fair and inclusive workplace. We monitor our gender equality index and remain committed to pay equity, transparency and equal opportunities across the organisation.


#### **The role itself**



If you join Alma, you will be able to grow and have an impact by:


* Influencing strategic decisions across the full Revenue organisation, from lead generation to churn.
* Combining analytical depth, business understanding and direct exposure to senior stakeholders.
* Helping Revenue teams build a stronger data culture and create more efficient ways of working as Alma scales across Europe.

### **Compensation \& benefits**


* **Competitive salary** based on 12 months
* **Profit\-sharing and employee savings plan**
* **Health insurance**: **100%** covered by Alma, including family package
* **Disability insurance**: **100%** covered by Alma
* **Sport**: partnerships with **Gymlib** and **ClassPas

jobs.title: Partner 20, Staff Security Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Founded in Silicon Valley in 2009 by Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz, Andreessen Horowitz (aka a16z) is a venture capital firm that backs bold entrepreneurs building the future through technology. We are stage agnostic. We invest in seed to venture to growth\-stage technology companies, across AI, bio \+ healthcare, consumer, crypto, enterprise, fintech, games, and companies building toward American dynamism. a16z has $100B\+ under management across multiple funds.



We've established a team that is defined by respect for the entrepreneur and the company\-building process; we know what it's like to be in the founder's shoes. We've invested in companies like Anduril, Airbnb, Coinbase, Cursor, Databricks, Deel, Figma, GitHub, Roblox, SpaceX, and Stripe. Our team is at the forefront of new technology, helping founders and their companies impact and change the world.


**The Role**
------------



We're hiring a Staff Security Technical Program Manager to run the operating system of the a16z Security team. You'll own the firm's vulnerability management program, drive cross\-team security initiatives to completion, and own the planning rhythm that keeps the team and its stakeholders aligned: sprints, OKRs, timelines, and the documentation and ticketing hygiene that make all of it real.



Security at a16z moves fast and touches every part of the firm. We work in close partnership with teams across the firm. Your job is to keep that work on schedule, keep decisions written down, and make sure nothing gets dropped between teams. Leadership should be able to get the real status from you, and engineers should see you as someone who removes obstacles, not someone who adds process.



This role requires an in\-office presence 2 days a week, Tuesday and Thursday, in our San Francisco, CA office, with occasional days in our Menlo Park, CA office.


**To join our team, you should be excited to:**
-----------------------------------------------


* Own security remediation across the firm, end to end: Pull findings from threat models, code reviews, penetration tests, vulnerability management, audits, and incident postmortems into a single tracked backlog, and manage it with clear owners, priorities, remediation SLAs
* Run the vulnerability management program: Scan coverage, patching cadence, exceptions and risk acceptance, and reporting that shows leadership where risk stands
* Work with stakeholders to keep vendor security reviews fast and consistent, and keep requesters informed on where their review stands
* Drive cross\-team security initiatives from kickoff through delivery, coordinating work across Security, IT, Legal, HR, and Compliance, and partnering with owners to keep commitments on track
* Build and run the team's execution rhythm: Sprint planning, quarterly OKRs, and ticket hygiene that keeps the work visible
* Raise the bar on documentation: Program docs, runbooks, decision records, and postmortem follow\-ups that stay findable and current
* Define and track the metrics that tell us whether our programs are working, and turn them into actionable insights

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------


* 7\+ years of technical program management experience, with at least 3 years running security programs
* A track record of owning a vulnerability management program at scale: SLAs, remediation tracking across teams you don't control, executive reporting, and measurable risk reduction
* Technical fluency to be credible with security engineers: you can read a finding, understand severity and exploitability, and push back on a risk rating with reasons.
* Knows the common SaaS tools (okta, Slack,GSuite etc) of an enterprise stack well enough to talk through their security issues with the teams that own them.
* Deep hands\-on experience with agile execution: sprint planning, OKR frameworks, ticketing systems (Jira, Linear, or equivalent), documentation platforms like Confluence or Notion, and building program reporting in spreadsheets or BI dashboards.
* Writing that is clear, brief, and structured
* Ability to build strong working relationships across functions like IT, Legal, Compliance, and engineering, and execute through those partnerships: work gets done with other teams, not around them.
* Low ego, high empathy, and the capacity to collaborate effectively with diverse teams


The anticipated salary range for this role is between $243,000 \- $284,000, actual starting pay may vary based on a range of factors which can include experience, skills, and scope.



This role is eligible to participate in the a16z carry program and various discretionary bonus programs as well as benefit and perquisite plans including health, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, 401K plan, vacation, and sick leave.

**a16z culture**
----------------


* We do only first class business and only in a first class way
* We take a long view of relationships, because we are in the relationship business
* We believe in the future and bet the firm that way
* We are all different, we recognize that, and we win
* We celebrate the good times
* We do it for the team
* We play to win


At a16z we are always looking to hire the absolute best talent and recognize that diversity in our experiences and backgrounds is what makes us stronger. We hire candidates of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, Veteran status, and any other status. These differences are what enables us to work towards the future we envision for ourselves, our portfolio companies, and the World.



Our organization participates in E\-Verify. Click here to learn about E\-Verify.



Andreessen Horowitz hereby reserves the right to make use of any unsolicited resumes received from outside recruiting agencies and / or individual recruiters without being responsible for payment of any fees asserted from the use of unsolicited resumes.

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Cyber Security Threat Analyst/Specialist \- Senior  

**Location:** Concord, CA; LOCAL CANDIDATES ONLY. The role is hybrid 3 days onsite (Tues, Wed, and Thurs) and 2 days wfh  

**Duration:** October 12, 2026 – April 09, 2027  

**Pay Rate:** $96/hr. W2  

TOP THINGS:  

- teamwork, curiosity, tenacity
  

WORK SCHEDULE: Monday through Friday (day shift) 6:00 AM to 2:30 PM.  


  

**Job Description:**  

  

**Department Overview**  

Responsible for the delivery of information security services including intelligence research, threat assessment, security event monitoring/analysis, vulnerability management and security tool administration in support of PG\&E’s enterprise security goals and objectives. Cyber Threat Specialists use a variety of commercial and custom tools and processes to provide the information security services mentioned above. Cyber Threat Specialists are experts in the operation of these tools and have the ability to design improvised solutions on the fly when dealing with active threats. Cyber Threat Specialists produce metrics and statistics that feed complimentary processes in PG\&E such as risk assessment, patching, anti\-virus, firewall management, etc. Cyber Threat Specialists are very technically skilled and have the ability to work successfully with other technical teams within PG\&E’s IT department and beyond.  

  

**Position Summary**  

The Monitoring \& Response Team (also known as M\&R) is the 24x7 security operations team that is essentially PG\&E’s first line of defense that is continuously preventing, detecting, analyzing, and responding to cybersecurity events to improve the organization’s security posture. The Monitoring \& Response Team is built with the foundation of a standard SOC but operates differently by utilizing Threat Intelligence in our daily investigations of security events. The Monitoring \& Response Team also operates in a proactive/reactive manner to maintain the highest level of efficacy in their tasks.  

  

**Job Responsibilities**  

- Monitors daily cybersecurity activity in shifts through looking at tools to determine if activity is malignant or benign and then engage others as required
  

- Provides analysis on malware and escalates as appropriate to incident response Teams
  

- Does baseline threat hunting based on intelligence for utility peers and other intelligence sources
  

- Provides hunting/analysis on phishing cases and reports of potential compromise/breach
  

- Performs proficient forensic analysis using security tools and monitoring systems to discover the source of anomalous security events
  

- Assists in performing basic research internally and externally
  

- Performs complex system administration tasks (e.g. customization, cross\-tool integration) for security tools
  

- Develops a strategy to implement work in department
  

  

**Qualifications**  

Minimum:  

- High School or GED\-General Educational Development\-GED Diploma
  

  

**Desired:**  

- Bachelors Degree in Computer Science or job\-related discipline or equivalent experience
  

- IT\-Information Technology Security certification

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, AI Infrastructure Capacity Planning
jobs.description:
Technical Program Management \- San Francisco

  


**About the Team**


OpenAI's Industrial Compute organization builds and operates the infrastructure required to train and serve frontier AI models. The Capacity Planning team connects rapidly changing research and product demand with the compute, networking, storage, power, data center, hardware, and operational resources required to make that demand executable.


**About the Role**


We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to build and lead capacity planning across OpenAI's large\-scale AI infrastructure. You will translate uncertain workload demand into clear infrastructure requirements, allocation decisions, supply commitments, activation priorities, and long\-range capacity strategies.


This role sits at the intersection of research, engineering, infrastructure, finance, sourcing, deployment, and operations. You will create the planning models, operating cadences, governance mechanisms, and source\-of\-truth systems that allow teams to understand what capacity is required, what is available, what is at risk, and what decisions must be made.


This is not a finance\-only forecasting or reporting role. Success requires technical fluency across the infrastructure stack, strong analytical judgment, and the ability to move consequential decisions forward when requirements, timelines, and supply conditions change quickly.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Own capacity\-planning processes across near\-term workload allocation, quarterly execution, and longer\-range infrastructure horizons.
* Translate research, training, inference, and product demand into compute, accelerator, cluster, networking, storage, rack, power, and site requirements.
* Develop scenarios that make assumptions, confidence levels, constraints, sensitivities, and decision points explicit.
* Reconcile requested demand against contracted, delivered, installed, activated, and workload\-usable capacity.
* Partner with research and engineering teams to understand workload priorities, technical dependencies, utilization patterns, and changing requirements.
* Partner with sourcing, finance, hardware, deployment, and operations teams to align supply commitments, activation schedules, costs, and delivery risks.
* Support allocation and prioritization decisions when infrastructure is constrained or delivery plans change.
* Track infrastructure lead times, critical dependencies, utilization, headroom, forecast accuracy, activation readiness, and capacity risk.
* Build dashboards, analytical tools, executive updates, and operating cadences that create a credible source of truth.
* Drive mitigation plans for site delays, hardware shortages, network or storage constraints, workload changes, and other capacity risks.
* Continuously improve planning models, governance, data quality, and accountability as OpenAI's infrastructure scales.

**Qualifications**


* 8\+ years of experience in technical program management, infrastructure capacity planning, cloud infrastructure, supply planning, or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated ownership of capacity planning for large\-scale distributed systemss, AI or ML workloads, or hyperscale infrastructure.
* Ability to translate ambiguous demand into structured assumptions, scenarios, technical resource requirements, and executable plans.
* Technical fluency across compute, networking, storage, data center infrastructure, utilization, reliability, and deployment dependencies.
* Strong analytical skills and experience developing planning models, operational metrics, dashboards, or data\-driven decision systems.
* Experience leading decisions across engineering, finance, sourcing, deployment, operations, and executive stakeholders.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain uncertainty, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly.

**Preferred Skills**


* Experience planning GPU, accelerator, or AI infrastructure capacity for training or inference workloads.
* Experience with cluster allocation, cloud capacity, hardware supply, infrastructure procurement, site readiness, or production activation.
* Familiarity with forecasting methods, scenario planning, optimization, cost attribution, capacity economics, and utilization management.
* Experience building planning tools or source\-of\-truth systems using SQLs, or similar technologies.
* Track record of improving utilization, reducing infrastructure cost or risk, and enabling critical workloads during periods of constrained supply.

**Location**


San Francisco, California. This role requires regular in\-person collaboration with infrastructure, research, and operational partners.


**About OpenAI**


OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general\-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.


We are an equal opportunity employeration, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities.

  


At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

$257K – $335K \+ Offers Equity

Dodge \& Cox is looking for an AI Governance Program Manager to keep the firm’s cross\-functional AI governance work organized, coordinated, and moving. This role sits within the AI Governance pillar, one of four pillars in the firm's AI operating model, with contributing cross\-functional members from InfoSec, Legal, Risk, and Compliance, which protects the firm and our clients through proactive management of AI policy and procedures, regulatory alignment, and risk management.


Reporting to the AI Governance Pillar lead, this person will be responsible for driving progress across the pillar’s many workstreams: coordinating Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Information Security contributors; tracking deliverables and deadlines; and facilitating the processes that allow the firm to make timely, well\-informed, well\-documented decisions about AI use so the firm can deepen AI adoption across every function with confidence. jobs.title: Product Risk Program Manager
jobs.description:
As a Specialized Assessment Product Risk Program Manager (SA PRPM), you will be a critical driver in Meta’s risk management and product integrity efforts. You’ll sit at the intersection of product, legal, and regulations — triaging and supporting risk review for new products and features that challenge company policy, introduce novel or untested risk, or require specialized scrutiny.Your work will shape how Meta assesses high\-risk product decisions, often in fast\-moving or ambiguous contexts. You’ll help guide cross\-functional partners through escalation workflows, support aligned decision\-making, and ensure that the right voices are in the room to evaluate complex tradeoffs. You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy—proactively identifying important problems, exercising independent judgment, and contributing to the strategy and roadmap for cross\-functional risk review. The ideal person will have exceptional judgment, strategic foresight, and the ability to operate across multiple risk domains.This is a senior individual\-contributor role. Success means managing and delivering large\-scale programs, aligning solutions across multiple teams, and gaining recognition as a subject\-matter expert whose advice is sought out across the product and risk community.  

  

  

### **Product Risk Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Support and manage the triage and escalation process for product risks that are novel, ambiguous, or policy\-challenging.
* Coordinate across Legal, Policy, Data Strategy, Engineering, and Product to ensure high\-risk reviews are surfaced and addressed with the appropriate depth and speed
* network with and appropriately involve key stakeholders, persuading diverse audiences to drive progress.
* Translate complex technical and product concepts into structured assessments and recommendations.
* Facilitate decision\-making through risk\-based frameworks that support both product velocity and compliance
* seek clarity on goals and priorities so work can move forward quickly, and escalate as needed.
* Ensure escalations are documented, tracked, and resolved with transparency and consistency, maintaining appropriate documentation and timely follow\-through.
* Identify gaps or breakdowns in current escalation/review processes and drive improvements in workflows, guidance, or tooling
* actively experiment and seek opportunities to simplify work through AI\-integrated workflows.
* Help Meta meet its legal and regulatory obligations and make decisions that reflect our mission, values, and principles, informed by risk reviews and compliance guidance.

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8\+ years of experience in program management, product operations, trust \& safety, privacy, compliance or in a related field
* Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver high\-pressure, high\-ambiguity projects involving dependencies across multiple stakeholders, teams, or functions
* Experience assessing and triaging novel or ambiguous product risks, particularly where no established policy, process, or precedent exists
* Strong communication and cross\-functional alignment skills — especially in navigating sensitive tradeoffs
* Familiarity with data flows, technical systems, and/or understanding of product risks and their applicable mitigations
* Track record of influencing decisions and driving progress without formal authority
* Experience building, improving, or operationalizing risk review, escalation, assessment, or governance processes
* Strong judgment in situations involving competing priorities, incomplete information, and significant business, regulatory, safety, privacy, or reputational risk
* Experience using AI/automation to improve complex workflows, analysis, decision\-making, or operational processes
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with comfort embracing ambiguity and improving systems

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working on privacy, content, legal, or compliance\-related product issues
* Experience with consumer\-facing technology, platforms, AI/ML products, infrastructure, or other technically complex products

Experience with product launches, 0* 1 products, emerging technologies, or novel product capabilities
* Experience working with AI agents, automation, or other emerging technologies to improve risk assessment and operational efficiency
* Understanding of regulatory, reputational, or policy risks related to consumer\-facing technology
* Experience developing and driving strategy or roadmap for cross\-functional projects and/or teams
* Background in triaging or adjudicating product\-level risks, ideally in a platform or infrastructure context
* Comfort presenting risk perspectives to senior stakeholders and leading through ambiguity
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. **DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Web Services is seeking a detail oriented, customer obsessed Program Manager for its Infrastructure Operations team.
  

  

Our Program Managers are able to quickly adapt strategies, plans and solutions in response to dynamic business requirements. They also must be comfortable interfacing and driving various functional teams and individuals at all levels of the organization. If you have previous project engineering experience, are ready to take on challenges, open minded, appreciate team comradely, have an occasional sense of humor and want to help Amazon raise the bar, then this role is for you!  

  

Successful candidates are natural self\-starters who possess the ability to design, develop and deploy innovative solutions to address operational challenges while driving these solutions to completion. This role requires both independent contribution as well as the ability to work within multi\-disciplinary teams (internal operations, engineering, legal, finance, procurement, environmental/health/safety, etc.). This individual has strong communication skills, is organized and thrive in ambiguity.
  

  

The scope of role encompasses program management of capital expense (CAPEX) and/or operational expense (OPEX) projects within data center operations. The scope of projects will include but not be limited to the improvement of electrical, mechanical, fire detection, building improvements, vendor (partner) management, and cluster wide maintenance coordination. An understanding of these systems is necessary, as the individual will be expected to identify areas for improvement as well as act on data provided from other teams and organizations.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

PDX is an AWS GovCloud region. As required by our contracts with the federal government, effective February 24, 2026, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States).

General knowledge of data center operations and facility management.  

  

Track record for being detail\-oriented with a demonstrated ability to self\-motivate and follow\-through on projects  

  

Ability to follow accurate and complete support procedures, system documentation, and issue tracking entries.  

  

Proactively and continually improve your level of knowledge about data center relevant technologies.
  

  

About the team  

Why AWS  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Diverse Experiences  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Construction is a trillion dollar industry that still runs on manual work. Contractors measure and count materials off drawings by hand, and it takes forever. Bobyard uses AI to automate takeoffs and estimates so bids get done 10x faster. We're Series A, backed by 8VC, Primary, and Pear, and revenue is doubling quarter over quarter.

**About the role**


As our first data hire, you will lay the foundation for our company\-wide data architecture and analytics strategy. You will design, build, and maintain our data pipeline and warehousing infrastructure, centralize fragmented data sources, and establish reliable metric definitions across the organization. In this role, you will work closely with cross\-functional leadership to deliver actionable insights, build high\-impact dashboards, and enable data\-informed decision\-making at every level of the business.

**What you'll do**

* Architect, scale, and maintain our central data warehouse and scalable ELT/ETL pipelines across internal systems
* Design robust data models and data transformation layers to turn raw operational data into clean, production\-ready datasets
* Establish, document, and standardize core business metrics and KPIs to ensure organizational alignment
* Deliver executive\- and operational\-level reporting, performance tracking, and analytical models for company leadership
* Develop intuitive BI dashboards and self\-service analytics tools for teams across business operations, product, and strategy
* Partner directly with key stakeholders across departments to identify analytical needs and answer strategic business questions
* Write clean, efficient, and well\-tested SQL and code to automate ingestion, data quality monitoring, and reporting
* Implement automated data validation, quality assurance tests, and governance practices as our data ecosystem matures

**What we're looking for**

* 5\+ years in analytics, analytics engineering, or business intelligence
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field
* Advanced SQL and hands\-on data modeling with dbt or an equivalent transformation framework
* Python for ETL and ELT work — API pulls, scripts, scheduled jobs
* You've built a data warehouse and its pipelines from scratch at a company under a few hundred people
* Real fluency in a B2B revenue funnel — you know what pipeline, CAC, and net revenue retention mean and why they move
* You can define a metric, defend the definition, and get a sales leader to adopt it

**Nice to have**

* BigQuery or a GCP data stack
* HubSpot as a source system
* Experience building financial or data controls, or supporting a SOC 2 audit
* You were the first data hire somewhere before

**What we offer**

* $140K–$160K base \+ equity
* Medical, dental, and vision, and a 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4%
* The whole data function to build, with the CEO reading what you ship
* On\-site in SF at 101 Second Street — we build together

 **Comp Philosophy**

We are proud to offer competitive, top\-of\-market compensation because we want to celebrate the dedicated people who ship amazing work and drive our success. Our individual compensation is thoughtfully tailored based on your role, experience, and contributions, alongside performance\-based rewards.


Compensation Range: $140K \- $160K

**The Role:**

JD Power’s Analytics team of over 200 professionals uses a hybrid, customized version of SAFe (scaled agile framework) to coordinate, execute and measure quarterly product development plans through planned cycles (program increments) to deliver value faster and more predictably. This role is responsible for the execution and ongoing optimization of that approach across sets of analytics professionals including data scientists, AI engineers, ML engineers, data engineers, software engineers, data insights analysts, data visualization and QA analysts, and data strategists. You will also interface heavily with partner teams in product and technology organizations as we move towards more consistent approaches across these teams. This is a high\-intensity, high\-visibility execution role involving the creation of net\-new data\-driven, AI\- and ML\-based products with our diverse set of automotive data assets.  



The role also evaluates, reports and conducts retrospectives on Analytics team operational KPIs for several of our major product areas involving our most complex, real\-time data sets that have high customer expectations and very fast customer response times. These metrics involve product quality, throughput, model accuracy and other identifiers. You will partner with Analytics leaders to identify, root cause and improve business performance, and evaluate and measure the impact of use of AI in our development teams.  



This role sits within the Transformation Office, the enterprise function responsible for orchestrating the programs and initiatives that underpin our three\-year strategy. Data and analytics are core to what JD Power sells and how we operate, particularly as our data assets and product development roadmaps have grown more complex and connected across multiple data sources. Your involvement in this position will ensure clarity of product development purpose and enable teams to effectively plan and ultimately own their development commitments. The Project Manager in this role is not a coordinator. · Applying a hybrid toolkit – technical project management, agile delivery, and business analysis to address the specific needs of each workstream


· Bring technical project management expertise to address engineering and AI challenges, working closely with technical leads and data scientists to monitor development progress and ensure alignment between business objectives and technical execution.


· Partner with Analytics leaders to set annual KPI objectives for year\-on\-year improvements. Proactively measure and report out on those KPIs and partner with technical teams to uncover root causes, implement retrospective actions and identify risks and countermeasures  



**What You Bring**

· Highly accountable, you own your commitments, follow through without being chased, and hold others to the same standard


· A self\-starter who can operate with limited direction, identify what needs to happen next, and move without waiting to be told

**Sentara is hiring a Senior Data Analyst!**
============================================


This position is fully remote.

**Overview**
============


The Senior Data Analyst supports the Batch Reprocessing and Payment Integrity function by designing and delivering the reporting, dashboards, and analytical tooling that measure operational performance across the claims reprocessing lifecycle. Working across multiple claims adjudication platforms and the team's ticketing and data warehouse environments, this role turns raw claims and workflow data into reliable metrics on cycle time, turnaround, recovery volume, and queue health. The Senior Data Analyst partners with operations leadership to define complex reporting requirements, builds repeatable and auditable data pulls in place of manual one\-off extracts, and contributes to data quality and stewardship so the team's operational numbers hold up under leadership and audit review. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role for someone fluent in SQL and claims data, not a generalist business intelligence position.

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Senior Data Analyst is the analytics owner for a healthcare claims reprocessing and payment integrity team operating across two health plan markets. The team handles overpayment recovery, claims reprocessing, provider contestment review, and the operational reporting that supports each. This role builds and maintains the data products the team and its leadership rely on to manage day\-to\-day work and to demonstrate performance against operational targets.


Key Responsibilities

* Design, build, and maintain operational dashboards and reports that track reprocessing cycle time, post\-approval turnaround, queue and hold status, stalled or aging tickets, contestment volume, and recovery throughput.
* Write and optimize complex SQL against multiple claims adjudication systems and an enterprise data platform, including queries that join claims data to ticketing and workflow data through established crosswalks.
* Replace manual, ad\-hoc extracts with documented, repeatable, and parameterized data pulls so that recurring reports are consistent and reproducible from one period to the next.
* Translate operational questions from team leadership into clear reporting requirements, and document those requirements so the logic behind each metric is transparent and defensible.
* Conduct ad\-hoc analysis to answer time\-sensitive operational and prioritization questions, including high\-dollar case identification and workload distribution across reviewers and analysts.
* Support data quality and stewardship efforts: validate that source data ties out, identify and document data gaps or anomalies, and flag conditions that would make a metric unreliable before it reaches leadership.
* Partner with IT and data platform teams on data access, source structure, and the migration of operational data off manual processes onto governed, auditable platforms.
* Produce reporting that is appropriate for a regulated, audited environment, including clear sourcing and documentation of report logic, while keeping the role's outputs limited to operational status and analytics rather than financial estimates or accounting determinations.
* Promote self\-service reporting where appropriate by building reusable, well\-documented data products rather than serving every request as a one\-off.

* Demonstrated experience writing production\-grade SQL against relational databases independently, not solely through a drag\-and\-drop reporting layer. (Required)
* Advanced SQL, Data visualization and BI development, with hands\-on Power BI experience
* Python coding, data warehouse using Synapse

new_jobs.title: Program Manager - Automation
new_jobs.description:
The **Program Manager (Automation)** is responsible for the successful delivery of complex, safety\-critical aviation and defense programs, with a primary focus on contracts supporting the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and related government agencies. This role owns full lifecycle program execution from capture and proposal development through system delivery, certification and final customer acceptance.


The Program Manager is accountable for program performance across scope, schedule, cost, compliance and risk ensuring all deliverables meet stringent regulatory, safety and contractual requirements. This individual serves as the primary interface with government stakeholders and leads cross\-functional teams in a highly regulated, mission\-critical environment.


Key Responsibilities

* Program Leadership
* Lead proposal development for FAA and defense\-related RFPs/RFQs in compliance with Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR/DFARS)
* Identify, vet and negotiate with subcontractors in accordance with federal procurement standards

* Develop compliant and competitive program plans including Statements of Work (SOW), Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), Integrated Master Schedules (IMS), Basis of Estimates (BOE) and resource plans
* Conduct risk and opportunity analyses
* Program Execution \& Delivery
* Lead end\-to\-end execution of FAA and defense programs, ensuring adherence to contractual, technical and regulatory requirements
* Establish and maintain program governance, including milestone reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, etc.)

* Direct cross\-functional teams delivering safety\-critical systems, including hardware, software and integrated solutions
* Oversee subcontractor performance, ensuring compliance with cost, schedule, quality and federal requirements

* Drive program closeout, including documentation, certification support and final government acceptance

* Support system certification and approval processes, including documentation, testing and validation activities
* Ensure adherence to applicable standards
* Maintain audit readiness for government reviews and regulatory inspections
* Ensure compliance with export controls (ITAR/EAR) and security requirements
* Risk, Change \& Performance Management
* Establish and maintain a formal risk and opportunity management process, including risk registers and mitigation plans
* Lead change control processes in alignment with contractual requirements, including engineering change proposals (ECPs)
* Monitor program performance using KPIs and Earned Value Management (EVM) as required
* Identify and resolve program issues proactively, including escalation to leadership and government stakeholders

* Develop and manage program budgets, forecasts and Estimates at Completion (EAC)

* Build strong relationships with government stakeholders, ensuring transparency and trust
* Align internal stakeholders and resolve cross\-functional challenges to maintain program execution
* Leadership \& Team Management
* Lead and influence cross\-functional, matrixed teams across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality and field services
* Drive accountability, performance and collaboration across all program stakeholders
* Mentor and develop team members, fostering a culture of excellence, compliance and continuous improvement

* Experience managing software\-intensive systems, automation platforms, or complex system integration programs.
* Experience developing and managing IMS, budgets, forecasts, risk management plans, and program execution strategies.
* Strong knowledge of program management principles, change control, performance measurement, and financial management.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams in highly technical environments.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with executive and government customers.

Preferred Qualifications

* Direct experience supporting FAA Air Traffic Management (ATM) or National Airspace System programs.
* Experience with FAA automation systems such as ERAM, STARS, TFMS, or related modernization programs.
* Experience with air traffic control automation, decision support systems, or mission\-critical operational platforms.
* Familiarity with FAA acquisition processes and government contracting.
* Knowledge of aviation standards including DO\-178C, DO\-254, DO\-278A, or related standards.
* Experience with cybersecurity requirements for government systems.
* PMP certification.
* Master’s degree in Engineering, Systems Engineering, B

**Location:** Hybrid \- Washington, DC metropolitan area. Work will primarily support the client on\-site in the Washington, DC area, with some work performed offsite at the contractor facility. Telework is available subject to coordination with the Government Technical Monitor (GTM) and completion of the client's required telework agreement.


**Contract:** Supporting a federal government client's enterprise IT modernization program. Potential five\-year period of performance, contingent upon contract award.


**Clearance/Screening Requirements:** Active Secret security clearance required prior to contract performance. Contractor personnel must comply with the client's security requirements and execute required nondisclosure agreements.


**Position Summary:**



PBG's McLean, VA office is seeking an experienced Senior Information Technology Project Manager to lead project management and operations for a federal government client's enterprise IT system. This Key Personnel role serves as the single management focal point for contractor execution in an Agile/Scrum environment, guiding the team, managing the project plan and schedule, communicating significant issues to Government leadership, and ensuring work meets cost, schedule, quality, and performance requirements.


**Key Responsibilities:**



The Senior Information Technology Project Manager shall be responsible for the following (subject to evolving needs):


* Serve as the single management focal point for contractor execution and maintain accountability for completion of all assigned tasks.
* Keep the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) and Government Technical Monitor (GTM) apprised of significant project, operational, technical, schedule, quality, or performance issues in a timely manner.
* Provide strategic guidance, vision, and direction to the multidisciplinary project team.
* Develop, manage, and maintain the project plan and schedule, ensuring tasks and deliverables meet cost, schedule, quality, and performance requirements.
* Bridge business processes and technical solutions by coordinating across Government stakeholders, developers, analysts, data scientists, and other team members.
* Drive teamwork, communication, collaboration, and commitment to timely task completion across the project team.
* Lead and support Agile/Scrum project management practices, including planning, prioritization, coordination, and status reporting.
* Conduct weekly status meetings with the COR and Product Owner and support reporting on progress, infrastructure and operations, upcoming enhancement releases, SOP development, and other performance matters.

* Support preparation and timely delivery of the Monthly Status Report and other required program deliverables, including the project schedule, training plan, system documentation, release notes, and deployment planning artifacts.
* Promote a customer\-focused approach and effective coordination with the wide variety of client stakeholders who use or support the system.


**Minimum Qualifications:**


* 10\+ years of experience in software development project planning and management.
* Experience managing IT projects in Agile development and Scrum team environments.

You will leverage OSINT and analytic tradecraft to uncover emerging threats and develop strategic products that help customers anticipate risks and look around the corner.  

  

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment that demands critical thinking, deep\-dive analysis, and the ability to manage competing priorities with exceptional attention to detail. They bring a genuine passion for delighting customers, collaborating across teams, and continuously raising the bar \- always seeking opportunities to refine processes, close gaps, and deliver more impactful products.

* Proactively identify and analyze relevant threats and trends and translate findings into actionable intelligence products.

* Support business continuity, crisis, and security management teams, including as needed outside typical work hours during security incidents and emerging crises.

At the heart of Defining Possible is our commitment to missions. In rapidly changing global security environments, Northrop Grumman brings informed insights and secure technological solutions to enable strategic objectives. At Northrop Grumman, you will have the resources, support, and team to do some of the best work of your career.

new_jobs.title: Lead Finance Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
**About Crunchyroll**
---------------------



Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super\-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200\+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in\-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.



Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

**About the role**
------------------



In the role of Lead Finance Data Analyst, you will report to the Vice President, Accounting Systems and Data Governance.



We are considering applicants for our Los Angeles, California office.



You will lead the analysis, governance, validation, and integration of finance data used across accounting, reporting, and finance systems. You will partner with Accounting, Finance, Technology, and business teams to define trusted data standards, strengthen SOX\-relevant controls, resolve data quality issues, and support changes to financial systems and interfaces. The role combines hands\-on data analysis with process and control leadership to help ensure finance data is accurate, complete, timely, traceable, and fit for downstream use. Success will be measured by improved data quality, effective control execution, and reliable delivery of finance data changes across the system landscape.


### **Core Areas of Responsibility**


* **Finance Data Governance:** Establish and maintain finance data definitions, ownership, lineage, critical data elements, data quality rules, and governance standards across source systems, integrations, subledgers, ERP, and reporting environments.
* **Data Quality and Validation:** Design and execute validation routines, reconciliations, exception monitoring, root\-cause analysis, and remediation plans to improve the accuracy, completeness, cutoff, consistency, and traceability of finance data.
* **SOX Controls and Auditability:** Partner with control owners to design, document, operate, and improve SOX controls over finance data, interfaces, system\-generated reports, master data, and change activity; maintain evidence and support audit and testing requests.
* **System Integration and Change Delivery:** Define finance data requirements and validation criteria for new or changed integrations, interfaces, transformations, and system implementations; coordinate user acceptance testing, cutover, defect resolution, and post\-production validation.
* **Change Management and Stakeholder Partnership:** Assess impacts of data and process changes, coordinate communications, training, and procedures, and lead cross\-functional issue resolution to drive adoption while minimizing control, reporting, and operational disruption.

**About You**
-------------



We get excited about candidates, like you, because...


* You have 8\+ years of experience in finance data, accounting systems, financial systems analysis, data governance, or related roles, including ownership of complex cross\-functional initiatives.
* You have a strong understanding of accounting data flows and financial reporting requirements, including how transactions move from operational systems through integrations and subledgers into the general ledger and reporting environments.
* You have hands\-on experience with finance data governance, including data definitions, ownership, lineage, critical data elements, data quality controls, metadata, and issue remediation.
* You have experience designing, executing, or supporting SOX controls over financial systems, interfaces, reports, master data, or data changes, and understand control documentation, evidence, and audit testing expectations.
* You possess advanced data validation and reconciliation skills, including SQL\-based analysis and structured testing of large financial datasets.
* You have experience with system integration and data transformation concepts, including source\-to\-target mapping, interface controls, file\- and API\-based integrations, error handling, and downstream reconciliation.
* You have led or materially supported system change initiatives, including requirements, user acceptance testing, cutover, post\-implementation validation, process documentation, and change management.
* You have experience with ERP and finance platforms such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Coupa, Concur, or comparable systems.
* You possess strong analytical judgment and can translate accounting, control, and reporting requirements into scalable data and system requirements.
* You have a bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field; CPA, CISA, or recognized data governance certifications are a plus.

**About the Team**
------------------



The Accounting Systems and Data Governance team connects accounting requirements, data standards, controls, and technology to support reliable, scalable financial operations. The team partners across Accounting, Finance, Technology, and business functions to strengthen finance data integrity and improve how financial information moves through Crunchyroll's systems. This role is a senior individual contributor and key point of coordination for finance data governance, validation, and change initiatives. Success is measured through trusted data, effective controls, and dependable system delivery.

* Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.

new_jobs.title: Implementation Manager - Strategic Accounts
new_jobs.description:
**Dynamo Software** est un éditeur mondial de premier plan de solutions SaaS de recherche et de gestion de portefeuille pour le secteur de la FinTech. Sa plateforme SaaS, hautement configurable et adaptée aux spécificités du secteur, répond aux enjeux de l’univers de l’investissement alternatif. Depuis plus de 20 ans, la plateforme Dynamo™ améliore la productivité des équipes de levée de fonds, de transaction, de recherche, de services aux investisseurs, de gestion de portefeuille et de conformité dans le monde entier. Ensemble, les plus de 1 000 clients de Dynamo gèrent plus de 10 000 milliards de dollars d’actifs. Soutenue par les plus grandes sociétés de capital\-investissement au monde – Blackstone Growth et Francisco Partners – Dynamo souhaite étoffer ses équipes pour répondre à la demande croissante pour ses solutions technologiques financières.

 **Aperçu du poste:** Tu accompagnes un portefeuille de clients stratégiques, du kick off à l'adoption durable de la plateforme. Chef d'orchestre d'un programme de plusieurs mois, tu coordonnes le client, les équipes internes (Produit, Tech, Sales) et les parties prenantes : chantiers en parallèle, interlocuteurs de tous niveaux, sujets techniques à trancher. Tu es le point de référence du client de bout en bout.

 **Descriptif du poste (au quotidien)**

  


1\. Phase de déploiement


* Construire et piloter le plan de déploiement : lots, jalons, dépendances, chemin critique
* Comprendre les spécificités du client pour adapter la solution à ses besoins : processus métier, cas d’usage, exigences techniques
* Déployer la plateforme avec le client et l’équipe technique : environnements, configuration initiale, flux d’intégration (API, webhooks, mappings de données, SSO, recettes)
* Tenir la gouvernance du projet : comités de pilotage, comptes rendus, décisions, risques et points bloquants

  



2\. Phase d’adoption


* Orchestrer la relation client en organisant les points réguliers et en conseillant sur les meilleures pratiques, grâce à une expertise fonctionnelle solide
* Former et accompagner les équipes du client, du key user à l’utilisateur final, y compris lors des changements d’équipe côté client
* Naviguer entre les interlocuteurs opérationnels, les équipes IT, les prestataires et partenaires du client et son comité de direction, en adaptant le discours au niveau d’interlocuteur

  



3\. Phase de fidélisation et expansion


* Collaborer avec les équipes internes pour garantir le succès des projets : avec les développeurs sur les problématiques techniques, avec le Produit pour adapter finement les fonctionnalités, avec les commerciaux pour identifier les besoins futurs
* Coordonner les projets spécifiques par un cadrage exhaustif des demandes, des dépendances et des zones de friction éventuelles, jusqu’à la mise en production
* Détecter de nouvelles opportunités en identifiant les besoins complémentaires du client et les axes de développement futurs, techniques ou fonctionnels

  


**Profil recherché:**


* Diplômé(e) de formation supérieure (eq. Bac \+5\)
* 6/7 ans d’expérience en tant que chef de projet implémentation dont une partie sur de la gestion de Grands Comptes : tu as déjà accompagné des clients stratégiques dans un contexte international
* Du cadrage : savoir distinguer le besoin réel du besoin exprimé, tenir un périmètre et un calendrier, dire non ou reformuler une demande sans dégrader la relation
* La capacité à traduire une contrainte technique en impact métier, et inversement
* Une vraie aisance technique : tu n’es pas développeur, mais API, webhook, mapping de données et environnement de recette font partie de ton vocabulaire, et tu peux échanger avec des équipes IT sans intermédiaire
* Fluent anglais/français

  


**Ce que nous offrons:**


* La possibilité d’avoir un IMPACT. Les bonnes idées viennent de chacun au sein de notre organisation. Nous sommes suffisamment agiles pour adopter de nouvelles idées et de nouvelles orientations.
* Une culture de travail très attractive au sein d’une entreprise technologique établie. Nous sommes fiers de notre travail et de nos équipes.
* Le candidat retenu aura l’opportunité d’interagir avec toutes les facettes de notre entreprise en croissance et de définir son propre parcours de carrière.

  


*Dynamo Software, Inc. pratique l’égalité des chances en matière d’emploi. Toutes les décisions relatives à l’emploi et à la gestion du personnel sont prises sans considération de race, couleur, religion, conviction, origine nationale, ascendance, sexe, âge, handicap mental ou physique, orientation sexuelle, identité de genre, caractéristiques génétiques, statut d’ancien combattant, service militaire, candidature à un service militaire, ou toute autre catégorie protégée par les lois fédérales, étatiques ou locales. Toutes les décisions relatives à l’emploi et à la gestion du personnel — recrutement, promotion, rémunération, avantages sociaux et rupture du contrat — sont et continueront d’être prises conformément au principe d’égalité des chances en matière d’emploi, et dans le but de le promouvoir.*

Si vous souhaitez compléter le dossier de candidature pour ce poste chez Dynamo Software et transmettre vos informations à notre base de données de candidats en vue de l’examen d’opportunités futures, merci de l’indiquer ci\-dessous. Si, à tout moment, vous souhaitez que votre candidature et vos données personnelles soient supprimées de notre base, veuillez contacter HR@dynamosoftware.com : nous donnerons suite à votre demande conformément aux exigences du RGPD.*
